subtitle: Keep Parsec and a separate RDP session running.
step_1_desc: Stop the installed host and its service.
step_3_desc: Open the original Parsec host without elevation.
step_4_desc: Start the service and verify the host.
app_note: You don't need to keep this app open after applying the fix.
risk_1: Your Parsec connection will disconnect during the change.
risk_2: Parsec capture and virtual-device features may stop working.
risk_3: Remote access may lose access to the sign-in screen, UAC and elevated programs.
risk_4: After a reboot, Parsec may be available only after signing in to Windows.
risk_5: If you cannot reconnect, use physical access or another remote connection.
ack: I have read the warnings and have an alternative way to access this computer.
progress_launch: Starting Parsec as a regular user…
progress_service: Restarting the service and checking the host…
progress_unknown: No update received from the elevated process.
progress_worker_exit: The elevated process ended before reporting completion.
progress_timeout: The operation did not finish in time. Check service state before retrying.
progress_launch_failed: Parsec did not start as expected.
consent_apply: Parsec will close and your remote session may disconnect. Do you have another way to access this computer?
consent_restore: Restore the privileged startup behavior? Parsec will restart and may disconnect your remote session.
elevation_detail: Please run this application as administrator to apply or restore the fix.
restore_detail: Original service startup and Parsec user startup will be restored.
not_supported: The installed Parsec configuration could not be read.
see_logs: Technical details saved in the operation log.
backup_missing: No backup was found for restoration.
